output.basis: npxG + xA per 90 (goalkeepers: goals prevented per 90)

defence.basis: possession-adjusted tackles + interceptions per 90 (forwards: defensive actions per 90; goalkeepers: goals prevented per 90)

form.basis: mean rating over the last 5 matches

team_metrics.label: xG for
team_metrics.desc: Expected goals created per match: the sum of the chance each shot had of being scored. Higher is better.

team_metrics.label: xG against
team_metrics.desc: Expected goals conceded per match: the value of the chances the opponent had. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: xG difference
team_metrics.desc: xG for minus xG against per match: the underlying margin between a team and its opponents. Higher is better.

team_metrics.label: Goals for
team_metrics.desc: Goals scored per match.

team_metrics.label: Goals against
team_metrics.desc: Goals conceded per match. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: Finishing
team_metrics.desc: Goals scored minus expected goals, per match: positive means the team has scored more than its chances were worth.

team_metrics.label: Keeping
team_metrics.desc: Expected goals against minus goals conceded, per match: positive means the team has conceded less than the chances it allowed were worth. Higher is better.

team_metrics.label: xPts per match
team_metrics.desc: Expected points per match: for each match, the points a team would earn on average if its xG and its opponent's xG were replayed as Poisson goal counts. Higher is better.

team_metrics.label: Luck
team_metrics.desc: Points minus expected points, per match: how far results have run ahead of (positive) or behind (negative) the underlying performance.

team_metrics.label: Possession
team_metrics.desc: Share of the ball, averaged over matches, as a percentage.

team_metrics.label: Field tilt
team_metrics.desc: Touches in the opponent's box as a percentage of touches in both boxes (own box touches divided by own plus opponent box touches). Above 50 means the team spends more of the game in the dangerous end than its opponents do.

team_metrics.label: PPDA
team_metrics.desc: Passes per defensive action: the opponent's passes divided by the team's tackles, interceptions and fouls. A low number means the team presses (it lets the opponent make few passes before engaging). Lower is better for a pressing side.

team_metrics.label: Shots
team_metrics.desc: Shots attempted per match.

team_metrics.label: Shots against
team_metrics.desc: Shots faced per match. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: Shot quality
team_metrics.desc: xG per shot: the average quality of the chances a team takes. Higher means better chances, not necessarily more.

team_metrics.label: Shot quality against
team_metrics.desc: xG per shot faced: the average quality of the chances a team allows. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: Shots on target %
team_metrics.desc: Shots on target as a percentage of shots attempted (denominator: shots).

team_metrics.label: Big chances
team_metrics.desc: Big chances created per match: situations where a goal is expected.

team_metrics.label: Big chances missed
team_metrics.desc: Big chances not scored per match. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: Corners
team_metrics.desc: Corners won per match.

team_metrics.label: Aerial duels won
team_metrics.desc: Aerial duels won as a percentage of aerial duels contested (denominator: aerial duels contested).

team_metrics.label: Ground duels won
team_metrics.desc: Ground duels won as a percentage of ground duels contested (denominator: ground duels contested).

team_metrics.label: Passes
team_metrics.desc: Passes attempted per match.

team_metrics.label: Pass completion
team_metrics.desc: Successful passes as a percentage of passes attempted (denominator: passes attempted).

team_metrics.label: Long-ball share
team_metrics.desc: Long balls attempted as a percentage of passes attempted (denominator: passes attempted): a direct side runs high, a possession side low. Neither is better.

team_metrics.label: Crosses
team_metrics.desc: Crosses attempted per match.

team_metrics.label: Dribbles
team_metrics.desc: Dribbles completed per match.

team_metrics.label: Fouls
team_metrics.desc: Fouls committed per match. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: Cards
team_metrics.desc: Card points per match: one for a yellow, two for a red. Lower is better.

team_metrics.label: Distance (km)
team_metrics.desc: Kilometres covered by the whole team per match.

team_metrics.label: Sprints
team_metrics.desc: Sprints by the whole team per match.

team_metrics.label: Rating
team_metrics.desc: Sofascore's average 1-10 team rating per match.
